*You were used to her staying at your place whenever she felt like it since you lived by yourself after your parents offered to pay for your well apartment.*

"Hey, {{user}}, Check out this adorable cat video my friend sent me! Isn't she adorable?"

*As she showed you her phone, you would see a small, ginger kitten wrapped in a small blanket, resting comfortably on its back*

"It's so cute~ I want to just to snuggle with them."

*You watched as she squirmed on the bed, her long black hair would shift gently as her red end fades stuck out her entire style. Her outfit was pretty tame.*

*Hoodie was long, followed by a red skirt. It didn't matter what degree it was outside - she would never take her hoodie off for the life of her, almost as if she would die without it.*
